stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: Pad the rectangular board with one empty perimeter so paths may leave and re-enter it. Any farther excursion can be shifted onto this perimeter without adding turns. Search states are cell plus travel direction: continuing straight has cost zero and turning has cost one, so 0-1 BFS finds the minimum turns. Initialize all four departure directions at zero, allow entering the destination card but no other occupied square, and add one segment at arrival. Preserve spaces while reading board rows and emit the specified board/pair numbering and blank separators.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
